text_block_list.text:
This happened when I was out with Ikuno 
Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it is almost time. Shall we be on 
our way, then—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Time to execute "Operation: Power Up 
Trainer"...!

Rewinding back a few days. It all started 
with a trivial exchange.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work in training. 
I must record today's data right away.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...The growth graph is looking steady. 
Let's keep this momentum going tomorrow as 
well.

"IRON WILL," a system for managing 
Umamusume data. Conditions and growth 
rates can be viewed in numerical values 
and ranks, with impeccable accuracy.

It seems this app's primary function is 
managing information. Which means—
choice_data_list:
...I wonder if it can tell my condition 
too?

...I wonder if it can tell my condition 
too?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Yours, Trainer-san? That... 
sounds interesting."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Height... weight... stride length... And 
then this, and that, and do it like this—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...T-This is...

Since I get a reasonable amount of 
exercise, I thought I'd get a decent 
evaluation. However, the result was 
surprisingly "Indeterminate"...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There's no need for pessimism, leave it to 
me. Management like this is where my true 
skill shines.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let us aim for it together. The moment we 
are acknowledged by "IRON WILL"...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You're looking good. Let's move right 
along to the leg press.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Unless you build up your lower back and 
hamstrings, running properly will be out 
of the question.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
One-two-three-four! Then bounce right 
there—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful!! Let's keep going and memorize 
right up to verse A.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If your stride is too long, you'll lose 
speed. Try increasing your leg turnover 
rate.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to rush. No need to 
compare yourself to others, either. Just 
focus on surpassing who you were 
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's input the latest data. 
Here we go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Muscle training, dance, uphill times... 
...With this...!
(Bzzzzt! "Unable to determine.")

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Great work for now. Make sure to stay 
well hydrated."

The sports drink permeates my fatigued 
body. An indescribable sense of 
fulfillment...

My physical capabilities have undoubtedly 
improved. I can say that with certainty, 
and it's all thanks to Ikuno Dictus's 
management.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
choice_data_list:
I'm fine, I'm not as down as you might 
think.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes, let's do our best tomorrow too!

More than any result, her presence alone 
is truly reassuring. Her management really 
is something special.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: How is it? Has the app been useful to you?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, actually. Right now, it's not 
about my information—

I explained everything that had happened 
so far to Tazuna... but.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Information on you is "Undetermined", 
Trainer? Um... Well, I suppose that makes 
sense!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Because this app can only manage girls 
who are registered as 'students' of Tracen 
Academy."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Leave it to me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
With my management, I will make sure you 
pass the Tracen Academy entrance exam...!
choice_data_list: That might be a bit too much...

I'm not an Umamusume, but I wonder if I 
can still pull it off...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...I suppose there's no choice but to 
give up. Still, it's a bit frustrating."
choice_data_list: Still, you were a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I feel like I gave it even more 
of everything I had than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Um... please make sure to use the app 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I remember the entrance exam questions 
clearly. I believe there's a high 
probability of passing the written test.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: No, um... you're joking, right?
